applies_why: The judge text resolves D5 vs C5 as UNDERDETERMINED and expressly says the relevant verses were answered, so it does not count any verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link.
quote: UNDERDETERMINED -- the sign's chapter bounds (Isaiah 7:16; 8:3-4; 8:8) are real, but C5's own narrowing concedes Matthew 1:23's application stands, and the almah/bethulah word-count cuts both ways (Joel 1:8); answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
rule_words: A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
room: 'counts toward a broken link' — one reading: any verse the judge calls 'real' counts even in an UNDERDETERMINED link; the other reading: the rule applies only when the judge counts a verse in declaring a link broken, which this text does not do.
why: The judge text labels the link UNDERDETERMINED and says the verses were answered, so it does not count them as unanswered witnesses toward a broken link.
